title: The Folding Desk Lamp
sourceTitle: A wholly fictional product concept; its features and experience are creative inventions.

scenes.title: What It Is
scenes.narration: Meet a fictional fold-out desk lamp. It gives a small desk a beam to read by. Then it folds flat, like a slim book.
scenes.sourceQuote: Meet a fictional fold-out desk lamp. It gives a small desk a beam to read by. Then it folds flat, like a slim book.

props.title: Folding Desk Lamp
props.subtitle: Open to light, close to store

scenes.title: Three Things
scenes.narration: This lamp does three simple things: open it to light the page, dim it to ease the glare, and close it to free up the desk.
scenes.sourceQuote: This lamp does three simple things: open it to light the page, dim it to ease the glare, and close it to free up the desk.

scenes.title: How to Use It
scenes.narration: Set it beside your book and open the shade. Press to dim it, then aim it at the page. Fold it shut when you finish reading.
scenes.sourceQuote: Set it beside your book and open the shade. Press to dim it, then aim it at the page. Fold it shut when you finish reading.

scenes.title: Limits and Next Step
scenes.narration: It won't replace your room's main light, and it may not suit every desk. Measure your desk before deciding on one.
